title: Prove exact mixed GL2 tariffs for disjoint address blocks
body:
## Result and exact scope

Proves an exact additive tariff for heterogeneous `GL2` targets on disjoint address-coordinate pairs. The six block labels `e,a,b,ab,ba,aba` cost `0,1,1,2,2,3` calls. Sum these costs over all blocks and target registers. The formula remains exact in every containing `GL_n(F2)`, with arbitrary cross-pair coordinate CNOTs, free scalar register mixing and any finite number of restored dirty registers.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c408f1c4082bff16837a930e11dc831de2babff/research/mixed-gl2-block-tariff/README.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c408f1c4082bff16837a930e11dc831de2babff/research/mixed-gl2-block-tariff/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c408f1c4082bff16837a930e11dc831de2babff/research/mixed-gl2-block-tariff/verify.py), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c408f1c4082bff16837a930e11dc831de2babff/research/mixed-gl2-block-tariff/SOURCES.json).

This is a scoped formal-model theorem. Each paid call has a scalar rank-one idempotent and costs one. The complete arbitrary-input endpoint must restore every unused register. The selected kappa stays `60403/20000000`. There is no native supplier or complete multiplication-exponent improvement.

## Method, novelty and credit

The mixed tariff at address dimension two already follows from Ross Richardson's [PR #1989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1989) and [GL2 bridge in PR #2415](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2415); see the [inversion-sum proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1/research/symmetric-adjacent-cut-bound/PROOF.md) and [bridge source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1/research/gl2-swap-cut-corollary/README.md). This PR does not claim that dimension-two result as new.

The extension uses James Reed's [averaged row-order method in PR #4950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4950), with its [retained proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1/research/swap-row-order-cut/README.md). One coordinate CNOT charges only the cut of its written pair. Its averaged charge is at most one unit, including cross-pair reads. The six target charges are exactly the listed tariffs. Summing disjoint cuts gives the lower bound; direct diagonal formal words attain it.

Cinna Davis's [fixed-three-register heterogeneous target and question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1/research/bit-mixed-transposition-triple/README.md) supplies another predecessor. The target `diag(a,b,aba)` costs five even with larger address spaces. The source notices also retain the earlier register/cut lineage. Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No predecessor executable is imported.

Base: `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`, priority revision 7. The changed task premise is the ambient coordinate alphabet and disjoint-block sum, not another fixed-register census. A final overlap refresh covered 318 open PRs, 4,130 Discussion records and 83 of 6,710 local notes. Its focused matches were this claim and package; sparse omitted notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

## Verification

CPython 3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-gl2-block-tariff
```

Expected markers:

```text
PASS_MIXED_GL2_BLOCK_TARIFF costs=0,1,1,2,2,3 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/mixed-gl2-block-tariff outcome=completed
```

Normal and optimized replay passed. The checker compares all six cut counts with independent group word lengths, checks 80 actual coordinate-CNOT cases over 31,992 relative orders, and verifies 7,128 complete diagonal formal endpoints and 39,852 call omissions. Nine boundary controls include a literal overlapping-pair product that drops from nine separate calls to three. Four actual code mutations are rejected with assertions disabled.

Exact source pins, base ancestry, committed bytes and a Git-free read-only optimized export replay passed. The full-history wrapper was not run in this shallow checkout. No independent human or proof-kernel review, native/compiler admission, selected cold replay or archive-wide sweep ran.

## Open next questions

Overlapping coordinate blocks need a different cost law: a list of their separate tariffs need not add. Unequal prices, rank-two calls charged as one, free address maps and restricted clean-input endpoints are outside this theorem.
